_note: One file per saved search; the filename (without .json) is the search's source label. Input schema = the harvestapi/linkedin-job-search Apify actor. 'geoIds' is a LinkedIn geo id — find yours by opening a LinkedIn jobs search for your city and copying the geoId from the URL, or check the actor's docs. Copy this file to e.g. searches/madrid.json and edit. Your real searches are git-ignored; only searches/example-*.json are tracked.
